onboarding.step1Desc: Click here to open model configuration; the top bar badges show real-time status of LLM, VLM, Grounding, ASR, image and video generation models. Required models must be configured before creating:
onboarding.step2Desc: Select a video scenario (short drama / editing / general), describe your idea in one sentence, you can also add files, folders or paste links to import assets. When required models for the current scenario are not configured, a prompt with direct access to configuration will appear here.
onboarding.step3Desc: Created projects appear in 'My Projects', click a project card to enter the creative workspace: Agent will plan the creative brief and timeline and generate frames. First-time entry also has a dedicated tour.
onboarding.projectTourBriefDesc: Agent's overall plan for the video: creative direction and brief are here, click the title to expand and view full content.
onboarding.projectTourTimelineDesc: Frames, edits, subtitle effects and sound are layered on the timeline. During new project creation, Agent is planning, track content appears in real-time as planning and generation results come in.
onboarding.projectTourDetailDesc: After Agent plans storyboards etc., click any item from the left list or timeline to view and directly edit its fields here.
onboarding.projectTourContextDesc: Select text anywhere on the page, or click to select a time point on the timeline, drag to select a time range, a 'Add to conversation' button will appear, sending selected content as context to the creative assistant.
onboarding.projectTourDockDesc: Enter modification intents anytime, @ to reference storyboards, assets etc.; Agent modification reviews and high-cost generation confirmations are also handled here.
onboarding.projectTourDownloadDesc: When all timeline content is ready, it auto-composes into a final cut; compose progress shows on the button. Open the menu to download the final cut video, or export the entire project as an archive.
onboarding.projectTourAssetsDesc: Generated storyboards, video clips and your uploaded assets are stored in the asset library, where you can view, reuse and reference them in conversations anytime.
onboarding.assetsTourDesc: All assets in the project are gathered here: your uploaded 'source' assets, Agent-generated 'artifacts' (storyboards, video clips, final cuts), and 'character / scene / prop' visual settings for scenarios like short dramas - e.g. the main character's reference image, which Agent references when generating storyboards to maintain consistency.
onboarding.assetsTourFilterDesc: Filter by source assets, generated artifacts, visual settings, or view only images / videos / audio, or search by name using the right search box.
onboarding.assetsTourUploadDesc: Upload files, or add links / text assets; after ingestion they appear in the list, Agent and timeline content can reference them.
onboarding.assetsTourDetailDesc: Click any card to view its version, reference relationships and artifact status; when you need to check or improve an asset, @ reference it in the creative assistant conversation.
onboarding.modelGuideLlmDesc: The brain for creative brief planning, storyboard scripts and Agent conversation
onboarding.modelGuideDramaGeneralDesc: Generate storyboard images and video frames, VLM handles visual quality review
onboarding.modelGuideEditUploadDesc: Understand the visual content of your uploaded images and video assets
onboarding.modelGuideAsrDesc: Transcribe speech in assets to text, for editing and subtitles
onboarding.modelGuideLlmProtocols: OpenAI Protocol, DashScope, Anthropic Claude, DeepSeek, Google Gemini, Qianfan, Volcano Engine, Custom
onboarding.modelGuideAsrProtocols: DashScope Fun-ASR, DashScope Qwen3-ASR, OpenAI Whisper
onboarding.modelGuideSetupDesc: Fill in Base URL, API Key and Model Name in 'Model Configuration', enable after passing 'Test Connection'; VLM can directly reuse multimodal-capable LLM configuration.
